sn22.5:1.7: Rūpassa samudayañ ca atthagamañ ca || vedanāya samudayañca atthagamañ ca || saññāya samudayañca atthagamañ ca || saṅkhārāṇaṃ samudayañca atthagamañ ca || viññāṇassa samudayañca atthagamañ ca || || 4
sn22.5:2.1: Ko ca bhikkhave rūpassa samudayo || ko vedanāya samudayo || ko saññāya samudayo || ko saṅkhārānaṃ samudayo || ko viññāṇassa samudayo || || 5
sn22.5:2.2: Idha bhikkhave abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati ||
sn22.5:3.3: tassa rūpam abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandi || ||
sn22.5:3.8: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || 7-9
sn22.5:4.1: Vedanam abhinandati || la || Saññam abhinandati || pe ||
sn22.5:4.5: tassa viññāṇam abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandi || ||
sn22.5:4.10: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti || || 11
sn22.5:6.1: Ko ca bhikkhave rūpassa atthagamo || ko vedanāya ||
sn22.5:7.1: Idha bhikkhave nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati || ||
sn22.5:8.3: tassa rūpam anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato yā rūpe nandi sā nirujjhati || ||
sn22.5:8.6: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti || || 14
sn22.5:9.2: tassa vedanam anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato yā vedanāya nandi sā nirujjhati || ||
sn22.5:9.5: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti || || 15
sn22.5:10.3: tassa saṅkhāre anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato yā saṅkhāresu nandi sā nirujjhati || ||
sn22.5:10.6: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti || || 17
sn22.5:11.2: tassa viññāṇam anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato yā viññāṇe nandi sā nirujjhati || ||
sn22.5:11.4: Evam etassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti || || 18
sn22.5:12.1: Ayam bhikkhave rūpassa atthagamo || ayam vedanāya atthagamo || ayaṃ saññāya atthagamo || ayaṃ saṅkhārānam atthagamo || ayaṃ viññāṇassa atthagamo ti || || 1 Sāvatthi ||
